claims.claim: IngestionTrack fields Source, Speaker (prefix 'SPEAKER: '), STT (required), TurnConfig (nil uses default)
Each track needs its own VAD instance because the detector is stateful
MultiTrackIngestion returns an IngestionFunc for WithIngestion; OnTranscript receives speaker and text per completed turn
WithIngestion and WithVADMode are mutually exclusive
Chunks are routed by Source; control signals are broadcast to every track; unmatched sources are dropped
EmitEndOfTurn is forced on every track
Errors for empty Tracks, missing STT, duplicate Source
Per-track stages: resample, VAD turn detection, STT, labeling, merged into one stream
